name: Shell and Shield
body:
You can use your shell and shield together to grant yourself cover against ranged attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Kappa, Shield Focus

Benefit: When equipped with a shield you gain partial cover (+2 AC and +1 Reflex saves) against ranged attacks, including spells, so long as you are not in melee.

This bonus does not stack with the bonus provided by Shield Focus.
